question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want Linda to date Kenji?
Did you like your Prom?
options: I haven't been to a Prom.

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: You have said enough, my young ward! I believe I have just the tuxedo for you! One moment please!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I love this guy!
A few minutes later, Brendan walks out of the changing room wearing...
A stylish goth tuxedo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! That's intense, man!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Intensely `awesome!` Dinah's gonna love this. I know it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Intensely [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color] Dinah's gonna love this. I know it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See? See? What did I tell you? The Gentleman's Depot looks after you! Now let's go rent a limo!
The single ugliest tuxedo Hector has ever seen! It's green on purple!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! That's... Uh... Yeah. That's a thing, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is hideous! I need to get another one!
An incredibly typical and unremarkable tuxedo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh. Weird. I expected something a little more off the beaten path.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't think this is Dinah's style at all... I should go try on another one!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nope, not an option. The tuxedo clerk has spoken, and his word is law.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trust me on this one, Brendan. These guys know `way` more about fashion than we do. If he says it works, it works.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me on this one, Brendan. These guys know [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] more about fashion than we do. If he says it works, it works.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...I guess.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now let's go rent you a limo!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: How truly mundane!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Truly eccentric!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Ah! You reject society's norms! I see!
What is her favorite Eastern European nation?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What is her favorite Eastern European nation?

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: So typical!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: That's... Quite unusual!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Ah! The tortured soul of a poet!
What is her favorite novel?

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Ugh! That's what `every` girl picks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh! That's what [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] girl picks!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: A young lady with a taste for the macabre!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: How... Bizarre!
What is her favorite holiday?

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: So she is thoughtful and melancholy, yes?

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Gaudy and ostentatious!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: How utterly boring.
Meanwhile, just a few stores down, Brendan and Hector are shopping at the 'Gentleman's Depot'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So do tuxes come in the usual sizes or what? Because I gotta warn you, I've got some gangly arms...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, man! You're at the number one tuxedo rental emporium in Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry about a thing. They'll take care of you.

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Buongiorno! Welcome to The Gentleman's Depot, where your wildest dreams come true!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Provided, of course, that your wildest dreams involve wearing high-quality-yet-affordable tuxedos.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mine do!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: How can I help you gentlemen today?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I kind of need a tux for the Prom tonight... It's no big deal though, I'm fine with something cheap and simple and...
The clerk lunges forward and slaps Brendan across the face!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, seriously! Why does everyone keep doing that?!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: A tuxedo is not 'no big deal'! A tuxedo is the `biggest` deal! It is the window into a man's soul!
nodes.text_bbcode: A tuxedo is not 'no big deal'! A tuxedo is the [color=#e23b3b][i]biggest[/i][/color] deal! It is the window into a man's soul!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've been telling him that, but he just won't listen!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Tell me, why do you even want to wear a tuxedo tonight?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Hector thinks my Prom date will really appreciate it...

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: The love of a good woman! Is there a finer motivation in life? I do not think so!

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: You must describe this girl to me! Tell me all about her, so that I may find you the tux that perfectly suits her desires!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Tuxedo Clerk
nodes.text: Tell me, what is her favorite bird?
What is her favorite bird?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All right, if you say so... I'll just go try it on!
A minute later, Linda emerges from the changing room.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well? How do I look?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... You look good... In a way...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Why hello, Opal! I missed you at Bingo last week!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Oh! My apologies, dearie! In that dress, I thought you were my good friend Opal!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: She bought a dress just like that in 1954! What a day that was!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: 1954...? I guess I should try on that other dress...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Bad news about that... While you were changing, Taylor came in and bought it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Weren't you holding onto it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Taylor's really intimidating, okay?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sorry, Linda... But I guess it's got to be the sundress...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All right, if you say so... I'll just go try it on!
A minute later, Linda emerges from the changing room.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well? How do I look?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... You look...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really, really good!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you sure?
Linda starts to answer, when suddenly a guy barges into the store!

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: Hey girl, I know we don't know each other... But I saw you from across the mall, and I just had to say hi!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! Hee hee! Hi!

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Out of my way! This girl's digits are all mine!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually, I'm not on the market... But I'm flattered that you'd ask!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I will literally do anything for you to go to Prom with me. Literally. `Anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I will literally do anything for you to go to Prom with me. Literally. [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow, Dinah! This dress was a great choice!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I knew you'd like it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... You really think she's going to be upset?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just saying, you might want to bring your dad's hanky to go with your dad's suit... Because you're going to need it when you're bawling your eyes out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because she broke up with you. That's why you'll be bawling.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I got that! What am I going to do? Prom's tomorrow, and I don't have anything planned!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, Brendan, old buddy. Crazy last minute schemes are what I do best!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no... What did I just get myself into?
The next day, Linda and Dinah head down to 'Fancy Dresses Deluxe' to shop for a dress!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I still don't know how I let you talk me into this... I'd already made up my mind and everything!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't worry, Linda! We're going to have a really good time together!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...I hope.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Hi, girls! How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, my friend was looking for a prom dress...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Uh, well, it's kind of last minute for that...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You're not out of dresses, are you?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: We're not out, per se... But we do have a somewhat limited selection.
A minute later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, they have two dresses in your size. They've got this yellow pastel sundress... And this sleek cocktail dress.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmm... The sundress is kind of old-fashioned... But the cocktail one is awfully slinky...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Which one do you think I should go with?

nodes.prompt: Which one do you think I should go with?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which one do you think I should go with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course you don't! But you know what? I don't want to watch 'LaGuardia Beach' every Wednesday night!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I do, Brendan. I do. And you know why? Because it's Amanda's favorite show!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Also, the girls are super hot. Like, whoa, hot. Oh man, there's this one blonde who's got these legs...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hector! Focus!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The point is, Prom Night isn't about you! It's about Dinah! And right now, you are letting her down.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Please! So she wears black lipstick and listens to The Kure! How different could she be?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Remember that shirt Amanda thought you looked so good in? The yellow one with the blue flames?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My Sure-Shot Shirt! Every girl I met thought I looked amazing in it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. Dinah thought you looked creepy. Also possibly color-blind.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh. Wow. I guess you have a point. Maybe she really is a pretty unusual girl...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But she's still a girl, dude. There are three things every little girl dreams about. Her wedding day, her Prom Night, and a unicorn that bakes cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Could you bake without opposable thumbs?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The point is, Dinah might not show it, but in her heart, she still wants to have that super-special Prom. And right now, you're letting her down.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't worry about those things, Linda! Leave them to me!
Meanwhile, across town, Brendan is hanging out at Hector's house playing some video games...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dude, for the last time, could you stop throwing me to the zombies at the last minute? We could've both made it to that helicopter!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't hate the player, hate the game.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh. That reminds me. I finally asked Amanda to Prom today!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah? How'd it go?
Earlier that day, in Centerscore Park...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, Hector, this is so nice! What a lovely picnic!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it's all right... But maybe you should look up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooo! There's a plane making sky-words! 'Amanda, will you be my date to Pro'...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Date to 'Pro'? That doesn't make any sense...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or does it?
Hector snaps his fingers. A nearby vendor releases a bunch of balloons that float into the sky adding the 'M' to 'Prom'!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeeeee! I will! I will!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, that's pretty elaborate...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it was great. How'd you ask Dinah?
Earlier that day, in Helzeroth...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Oh, hey Dinah, do you wanna go to Prom?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Sure, why not?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Did you just say that you asked her out through that Warscrewdriver game?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... Why, is that wrong?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, man, I think it's great!
Hector leans over and slaps Brendan across the face!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course it's wrong! You do `not` ask a girl to Prom through a video game!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course it's wrong! You do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] ask a girl to Prom through a video game!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What were your plans for Prom Night? Show up in your dad's old suit and make her drive?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I mean... It's a pretty good suit...
Hector slaps Brendan again!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dude! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dinah's graduating this year! This is her last chance to go to a real Prom! You can't act like it's no big deal!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I just don't think you properly understand the situation!

options.label: I don't even want to go to Prom!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm telling you, Dinah, you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And I'm telling you, Linda, I won't! What are the three things that make me most nervous?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Big crowds, flash photography, and dancing in public?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmm. I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Please, Linda. You're my... My best friend. Having you there would mean `so` much to me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, Linda. You're my... My best friend. Having you there would mean [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much to me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I guess I don't want to let a friend down!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Except... Wait... How could I go? Prom's tomorrow, and I don't have a dress or anyone to do my hair and makeup!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't even have a Prom ticket... I gave away the one that Howard got for me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Please! What's so good about Prom that I'm going to regret missing it?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The lame decorations? The awkward moments? Standing around wishing I had a guy to dance with?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Is that what this is really about? Do you not want to go because you don't have a date?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! That's... That's ridiculous! I can't believe you'd even think that!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So you're telling me you'd be totally okay going to Prom without a date?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Then prove it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `Fine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So you'll go to Prom?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Even if I wanted to, how could I? Prom's tomorrow, and I don't have a dress or anyone to do my hair and makeup!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't even have a Prom ticket... I gave away the one that Howard got for me!
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: There! Done!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow, Dinah! That looks really great!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you sure? It feels the same...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Trust me, Linda. Dinah did a really good job!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now it's my turn to do your makeup! You are going to look `so` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now it's my turn to do your makeup! You are going to look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'll leave Linda in your capable hands, Amanda. I have to go find her a Prom ticket!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds like a plan, chief. You search up by the trees, I'll search down by the river!
A little while later, Brendan comes limping out of the woods to find Hector texting on his cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, dude, you look terrible! What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought I'd found the flower... But then this raccoon attacked me... And while I was fighting it, I rolled onto this hornet's nest, and...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute! Did you even look for the flower, or were you just sitting here texting?
Brendan steps forward and slaps Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, Brendan, I suppose I deserved that. But before you get too mad, why don't you check out this text Amanda sent me?
Hector passes Brendan his phone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh come on, dude! That's just inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And also, that is not how you spell 'pomegranate'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What, was I just supposed to `ignore` that? That'd be impossible!
nodes.text_bbcode: What, was I just supposed to [color=#e23b3b][i]ignore[/i][/color] that? That'd be impossible!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But fine, fine. I'll go help you look for this flower...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I'm not going back in there! What if that raccoon's got a posse?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's just stop by the flower shop on the way home. I'll buy a rose or something...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You sure that makes sense? Won't we cover more ground if we split up?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, Hector. I know you. If I leave you alone, you're just going to stand around sending flirty texts to Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dang, man. It's like you can see the future or something.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now come on!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are we looking for again?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A tall, black plant with a sleek, crimson blossom!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean... Like this one?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's it! You found it! Thanks, man!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No problem! Now let's go get ready and give our girls the Prom of their lives!
And down at Lake Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Remind me why we're down by the lake again?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You said I need to get a corsage, right? And if I'm getting a corsage, then I'm going to find Dinah's favorite flower... Which just so happens to grow down by the lake!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What is it? The Black-Lace Skull Tulip?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, Hector. Way to stereotype, man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: For your information, it's the Dark-Frills Shadow Orchid.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I rest my case. Now how do we find this thing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, it's a tall, black plant with a sleek, crimson blossom... It grows somewhere around here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think we should...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh. Wow. Seriously? You're trying to buy my ticket... So you can give it to Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's pretty cold, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No! It's... It's not like that! I didn't know it would be `your` ticket!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! It's... It's not like that! I didn't know it would be [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] ticket!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man, I kind of thought Linda wouldn't even `go` to Prom. You know, because she didn't have a date.
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, I kind of thought Linda wouldn't even [color=#e23b3b][i]go[/i][/color] to Prom. You know, because she didn't have a date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait. Don't tell me. Kenji asked her, didn't he?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, Howard, it's not like that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to sugarcoat it for me, Dinah. I can take a little truth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here. You can take my ticket for free. I just want to be rid of it at this point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See you later, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... Howard...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I got the ticket... But I don't feel good about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan? But he already has a Prom ticket! I was with him when he bought it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! Well! He... Uh... Lost it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He... Lost it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh! Classic Brendan! That guy is always losing everything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you ever hear about the time he got up in class to turn in his math final and lost it halfway to the teacher's desk?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They found it in a drinking fountain on the other side of school. It's like that dude has the world's worst superpower.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee hee! That does sound like Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, here's the ticket.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Have a good time, you two!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't the most honest approach... But today, I think it was for the best!
Meanwhile, Dinah has just driven to the parking lot of Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Phew! I can't believe how lucky I am!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The very first `Student Want Ad` I looked at was someone trying to sell their Prom ticket!
nodes.text_bbcode: The very first [color=#3b78e2][i]Student Want Ad[/i][/color] I looked at was someone trying to sell their Prom ticket!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Now, let's see... The ad said to meet in the Centerscore Parking Lot...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dinah! Hey! Are you looking for me?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! Howard! Are you the person who was selling their Prom ticket?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yep, that's me. I was all excited to go, but then... Well, you know, Linda and I, we... The point is, I'm not going.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: If you're not going to Prom, then why are you wearing a tux?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'd already put down the deposit on the rental, so... Why not, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you need the ticket for, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I'm getting it for...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I know. Rules `are` rules. But can't even rules be broken with the proper...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I know. Rules [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] rules. But can't even rules be broken with the proper...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Incentive?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Incentive?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: ...Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, he thinks you're hitting on him!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! No! I mean, money! Money is the incentive!

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: A bribe? You're offering me a bribe?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is that... Okay?

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: No, it's not okay! I don't need your pathetic bribe, kid! I'm Fancy Fred, owner of this joint! I'm worth 4 million dollars!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then why are you driving a limo?

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: Because it's the only way I can distract myself from the crippling, soul-crushing malaise that is my life!

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: And you know why my life is so empty? Because I'm always stuck dealing with snot-nosed, bribe-giving, ambiguously-flirting brats like you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're... We're sorry...

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: You'd better be sorry! Now get out of my shop and don't come back!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, sir, I know it's not company policy. But it's really important to me that I rent this limo tonight!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's Prom Night, and if I don't have a limo, my girlfriend is going to be really upset.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's graduating this year, so this is the only Prom we'll get! Please, sir, you have to understand! I need this for love!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sir? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: It was 1989. Her name was Genevieve Madison. Her hair was red like a sunset, and she had a smile that could break your heart.

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: I was supposed to take her to Prom. She was so excited. She had everything picked out... A dress, flowers, the restaurant.

nodes.text: But I panicked. I got cold feet. And I didn't show up.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Stupid... Paula... Stupid... Prom... I didn't even want to go in the first place...

nodes.speaker: VOICE
nodes.text: Sounds like you're having a rough time.
Linda looks up as Kenji walks out from the shadows, wearing a classy tux!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji! What are you doing here? You told me you hated Prom!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And you told me you weren't going to go this year. But here you are. And you know what? I had a feeling you'd be here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You rented a tux and came to Prom because you had a feeling I'd be here?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I ran into Hector earlier today, and he said something that kind of got to me.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He said that if I didn't go, I'd regret it. I thought about that, and I realized it was true.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not that I'd regret not going to Prom... But that I'd regret not going to Prom with `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that I'd regret not going to Prom... But that I'd regret not going to Prom with [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... I...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I know, I know. You said you didn't even want to go to Prom, but...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, that's not it at all. I wanted to go Prom. `Of course` I wanted to go to Prom.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, that's not it at all. I wanted to go Prom. [color=#3b78e2][i]Of course[/i][/color] I wanted to go to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I didn't want to go without you. I think I just realized that.
Kenji steps forward and takes Linda's hands.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda... Will you be my Prom date?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I will!
Kenji kisses Linda, holding her close! The two stand together for one long, tender moment...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Kenji... I'm so happy you're here.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not as happy as I am to be here. Now come on. Let's go in there and have the Prom Night of our lives!
Wow! Linda went from not wanting to go at all to having the best Prom ever... All thanks to you!

nodes.text: Oh! Wow! That's... Surprising!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It looks terrible, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, no, it's very... Cool! Trust me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Wow. That is... Um... A pretty... Unusual...Tux...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't like it, do you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Is this one of those cases where I'm supposed to politely lie?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, it's okay. I'm not a huge fan of it either...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I love your corsage, Brendan! Is that... A Dark-Frills Shadow Orchid?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep! I found one just for you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, Brendan, you're the best! Now let's go to Prom!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure thing! I've got a limo waiting for us around the corner!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A limo! Wow! I've never even been in a limo!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, one thing... Is it okay if Linda comes with us?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure! The more the merrier, right?

Enjoy your bonus scene, and find out how some of the other students at Centerscore High are enjoying their Prom night!
On one side of the dance floor, Mallika dances with Spike while Kim dances with Phil...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know what, Spike? When this school year started, I never expected I'd be dancing at Prom with you... And I couldn't be happier!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Funny how life is, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Having a good time, Phil?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: With you? Always, babe!
Meanwhile, at the other end... Hector dances with Amanda while Paula dances with Zach...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amandabear, you are so, so, so pretty tonight...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww, Hecky! Smooch!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hey! You! What's the matter with you?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you... Crying over Amanda?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No! Shut up! I'm not crying! I've just got leaky eyes!
And at the far corner of the gym, the nerds lean against the wall and watch from the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What a bizarre social ritual. The Prom King and Queen are elected via a democratic vote... Arguably the antithesis of a monarchy!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Maybe it's an ironic commentary on the fallen role of tradition within our contemporary society...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Speaking of kings and queens, Spud... Want to go log on and play a quest or two?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Only if by 'play a quest', you mean 'make out in your car while role-playing our characters'!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Say, Angie... Why isn't Darren here?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We had kind of a fight this weekend... I don't know, things are really rough these days.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Well... In that case... Would you like to dance with me?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Just this once... Why not?
And out on the football field, Andy and Lucretia lay together, looking up at the stars...

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Wow. I'll be honest, Andy, I had my doubts when you asked me to your Prom... But this is actually really, really nice.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I told you, angel. You just gotta trust me.
And in the parking lot, a certain limo driver is reflecting on the past...

nodes.speaker: Genevieve
nodes.text: Fred?

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: Genevieve? Genevieve Madison? What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Genevieve
nodes.text: I... I came to find you, Fred. I `had` to find you.

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: Genevieve, I... All those years ago at Prom... I made a terrible mistake! I should never have let you out of my life!

nodes.speaker: Genevieve
nodes.text: Fred, there's something you need to know. Stan and I got divorced last year. It wasn't working... We were never meant to be...

nodes.speaker: Genevieve
nodes.text: Because in my heart, I know I was always meant to be with you!

nodes.speaker: Limo Driver
nodes.text: Come here, beautiful! This is the greatest day of my life!
